input.description: 本機 session store 盤點
input.prompt:
GOAL: Inventory ALL agent-CLI session stores on THIS local machine (macOS) for three CLIs: codex, claude (Claude Code), agy. This drives a weekly usage retro covering 2026-07-25 through 2026-08-01, INCLUDING archived/compacted sessions.
SCOPE: Check at minimum: ~/.codex/sessions, ~/.codex/archived_sessions, ~/.codex/rollout* dirs; ~/.claude/projects (session .jsonl per project), ~/.claude/history*, any archive/trash subdirs; for agy: look in ~/.agy, ~/.config/agy, ~/Library/Application Support — discover live, do not assume. Also note ~/.codex/memories/rollout_summaries if present.
ACCEPTANCE:
- For each CLI: every session-store path found, listed as absolute path + file count with mtime within last 7 days (find -mtime -7) + total size + one-line note on format (jsonl? dir-per-session?) and how archiving works (separate dir? flag in file?).
- Sample ONE recent file per store: report its first-line structure (keys only, no content dump) so the analyst worker knows how to parse.
- Zero-result duty: before reporting a CLI has no store, prove your search pattern works on a known positive (e.g. locate claude's store first); an unproven zero = UNCONFIRMED.
NON-GOALS: Do not analyze session content, do not review quality, do not propose fixes.
REPORT: return ONLY short conclusion bullets + path per claim + counts. Hard cap 30 lines. Do not paste file contents or logs. If you cannot meet an acceptance criterion, say which one and why — do not fake it.

handback_report.text:
Scope note: today is 2026-10-09, so "-mtime -7" selects Oct 2-9, not the retro window 07-25..08-01. I give both: -mtime -7 (acceptance) and window counts via -newermt, which reflect last-write time and undercount files touched later.

CODEX
- ~/.codex/sessions: 185 files (153 .zst, 25 .jsonl), 103M. Layout sessions/YYYY/MM/rollout-<ts>-<uuid>.jsonl(.zst). mtime<=7d: 25. Window: 25.
- ~/.codex/archived_sessions: 2264 files (2232 .jsonl.zst, 32 .jsonl), 1.6G, flat dir. mtime<=7d: 32. Window by filename date (rollout-2026-07-25..08-01): 488; by mtime: 488. Archiving looks like relocation from sessions/ to this flat dir; .zst appears in both dirs, so compression is independent of archive status (inferred, not verified in code).
- ~/.codex/memories/rollout_summaries: 182 .md (+DS_Store), 980K, mtime<=7d: 66. Markdown summaries, not transcripts; filename = timestamp-id-slug.
- Empty but present: ~/.codex/memories_v2/rollout_summaries (0 files), ~/.codex/rollout-migrations (0 files). Lock files only in ~/.codex/.tmp.
- Sample (archived .jsonl, and one .zst decoded to stdout only): top-level keys ordinal, payload, timestamp, type. payload (session_meta) keys include id, session_id, cwd, git, cli_version, model_provider, source, timestamp.

CLAUDE
- ~/.claude/projects: 57 project dirs (encoded cwd names, e.g. -Users-<user>-github-agent-scripts), 705 session .jsonl (one per sessionId), 1.8G; plus tool-result json/txt and other subfiles. mtime<=7d: 274 jsonl. Window by mtime: 0 (files were modified after the window; use in-file timestamps instead).
- Sample first line of a recent .jsonl (keys only): leafUuid, sessionId, type. Other lines carry operation, sessionId, timestamp, type.
- ~/.claude/projects_archived: 536 files (534 .gz, 1 .tsv), 165M, mtime<=7d: 0, window: 0. Gzipped copies of older project data (inferred archive mechanism; not decompressed).
- ~/.claude/history.jsonl: single file, 7.8M, 14,177 lines (global prompt history, not per-session).
- Not transcript stores: ~/.claude/backups (5 files), ~/.claude/plugins/.trash (20 files), ~/.claude/sessions (9 files), ~/.claude/session-env (327 dirs).

AGY (binary: ~/.local/bin/agy, Mach-O arm64, 178MB; this is the CLI, not a store)
- ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli: 175 files (74 .txt, 24 .jsonl, 22 .md, 15 .json, 11 .log, 7 .lock), 24M. mtime<=7d: 175. Window: 0. Best candidate for the agy session store; its history.jsonl keys are display, timestamp, type, workspace. Other file formats not confirmed as transcripts.
- ~/.local/state/agent-hooks/<session-uuid>/agy-transcript.jsonl: 36 .jsonl across 69 files, 608K, mtime<=7d: 69. Keys: timestamp, type. Hook-written transcript, one per session dir.
- ~/.antigravity: 3 files, 16K (agy_daemon.log, argv.json, bin/extensions). mtime<=7d: 0. Not a session store.
- ~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity: 810 files (597 .log, 14 .vscdb, 14 backup), 11M, mtime<=7d: 0. App/IDE state, not agent session store.
- ~/.cache/codeburn (antigravity-results*.json, session-cache.v9/antigravity.*.json): derived usage cache, not primary.
- Absent: ~/.agy and ~/.config/agy do not exist. ~/.cache/antigravity exists but is empty.

Zero-result proof: the search pattern was confirmed positive on known stores (.claude/projects, .codex/archived_sessions, and agy via find -iname '*agy*' / '*antigravity*', which located ~/.antigravity, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli, and the Application Support dir).

Gaps: only one .zst was decoded (sampled), not all 2385. Claude window counts are unverifiable by mtime. Not analyzed content.
Skipped: decompressing archives beyond samples, and deep format review of agy-cli files. Risk: Claude and agy window counts by mtime are unreliable.
